title: AI 应用与 LLM
intro: 从已有的编程基础出发，按模型调用、输出控制、知识检索和效果评估的顺序推进。
english: Start with programming fundamentals, then explore model calls, output control, retrieval and evaluation.

steps.title: 从 Java 后端到第一个 LLM 应用
steps.en: Your first LLM application from Java
steps.outcome: 规划目标：完成一次模型请求，理解输入、输出与错误处理。
steps.outcomeEn: Goal: make a model request and understand inputs, outputs and errors.

steps.title: 提示词与结构化输出
steps.outcome: 规划目标：围绕固定任务比较提示方式，检查输出是否符合约定。
steps.outcomeEn: Goal: compare prompts for a fixed task and check output requirements.

steps.title: 给个人博客做一个知识库问答
steps.en: Build a Q&A system for this blog
steps.outcome: 规划目标：串联文档处理、检索和回答，保留可追溯的来源。
steps.outcomeEn: Goal: connect document processing, retrieval and answers with sources.

steps.title: 评估效果，记录失败，复盘改进
steps.prerequisite: 一个可运行的应用原型
steps.outcome: 规划目标：建立固定问题集，记录效果、延迟、成本与局限。
steps.outcomeEn: Goal: build a fixed question set and record quality, latency, cost and limits.

title: 具身智能入门
intro: 独立于应用开发路线，从概念与阅读开始，再进入仿真；不预设你已经拥有机器人硬件。
english: A separate path from concepts and reading to simulation. No robot hardware is assumed.

steps.title: 理解感知、决策与行动
steps.outcome: 规划目标：梳理任务、观测与动作之间的关系，明确学习问题。
steps.outcomeEn: Goal: map tasks, observations and actions and define learning questions.

steps.title: 带着问题读一篇论文
steps.en: Read a paper with a question in mind
steps.outcome: 规划目标：记录任务设定、方法、实验条件和原文局限。
steps.outcomeEn: Goal: record the task, method, experimental conditions and limitations.

steps.title: 第一次仿真实验
steps.prerequisite: 基础概念与 Python 基础
steps.outcome: 规划目标：完成环境搭建与一个最小任务，记录实际结果。
steps.outcomeEn: Goal: set up an environment, run a small task and record the actual result.
